Is SINNERS a Musical?


Polyphonic dives into the question of whether the new film Sinners qualifies as a musical, pointing you to Leah Schnelbach’s deep-dive on Reactor Mag for the skinny on all that Irish-flavored soundtrack magic. And hey, if you’re as obsessed with music history as we are, don’t miss the pre-order for Century of Song, where Noah LeFevre charts the 100 most important songs of the last century.
Want to support the show or snag exclusives? Grab 20% off awesome math and science lessons at Brilliant.org/polyphonic, back us on Patreon, join the Polyphonic Discord, or follow the conversation on Twitter. Happy listening!
Watch on YouTube

articles.description:

One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 is getting a next-gen glow-up in the latest Nintendo Direct trailer—think crisper graphics, massive hordes of enemies to pummel, and all the high-octane action you’ve come to love.
Plus, new DLC characters are dropping to beef up your crew, and it’s launching on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Official Next Gen Update Trailer | Nintendo Direct

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Get hyped for the Switch 2’s powerhouse lineup! Nintendo just dropped a slick montage in its latest Direct, teasing enhanced versions of EA FC 26’s stadium thrills, the stylish RPG Persona 3 Reload, the eerie atmosphere of Little Nightmares 3, and plenty more. With boosted graphics and smoother frame rates, these next-gen upgrades really show off what the new hardware can do.
Whether you’re chasing sports glory, diving into JRPG nostalgia, or braving spooky puzzle-platformers, the Switch 2 has something for every gamer’s wishlist. And this is only the beginning—there’s a ton more on deck for launch and beyond!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Nintendo Switch 2 Enhanced Games Montage - EA FC 26, Persona 3 Reload, and More! | Nintendo Direct

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
At this Fall Direct, Nintendo teased a flood of games coming to Switch and Switch 2: a Super Mario Galaxy movie in spring 2026 (paired with Switch 2 ports of both Galaxy games), a brand-new Pokémon adventure called Pokopia, fresh Donkey Kong Bananza DLC, and a strategy-packed Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave.
Whether you're hyped for platforming nostalgia, starting a new Pokémon journey, or diving into castle battles, Nintendo has you covered with enough content to keep your Joy-Cons busy well into next year.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Everything Announced at the Nintendo Direct (September 2025)

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies reimagines the MCU as a gritty, four-part animated horror event where the Avengers succumb to a zombie plague. A brave band of survivors must scramble across a decimated world to find the cure and save what’s left of humanity.
Featuring the voices of Elizabeth Olsen, Paul Rudd, Florence Pugh, David Harbour, Tessa Thompson, Simu Liu, Awkwafina, Hailee Steinfeld, and more, this epic series—executive produced by Kevin Feige and team—drops exclusively on Disney+ starting September 24.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Marvel Animation's Marvel Zombies - Official Trailer #2 (2025) Elizabeth Olsen, Paul Rudd

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
This clip dives into a sealed battle room in Hunter’s March, where you’ll face off against swarms of bugs in Hollow Knight: Silksong. The arena stays locked until you trigger the encounter, turning the fight into a high-stakes gauntlet.
If you’ve tracked down Shakra in Hunter’s March she’ll tag along as backup—just don’t arrive too early or too late, since her whereabouts shift with your progress through the map. For more tips on Silksong and NPC locations, check out IGN’s dedicated wiki.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Hollow Knight: Silksong Locked Arena/Battle Room - Fighting With Shakra (Hunter's March)

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
We just went hands-on with Nintendo’s new paid DLC for Donkey Kong Bananza. The highlight is DK Island—a 90s throwback brimming with nods to Rare’s glory days (think Country, 64, Jungle Beat, and more).
Even better is Emerald Rush, a speed-running remix that strips DK of all his powers and dares you to strategically reclaim them while hoarding emeralds. It’s fast, frantic, and utterly destructive—a perfect hardcore post-game rush for Bananza fans.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: We Played Donkey Kong Bananza's Totally 90s DLC - NVC Clips

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Get ready to flop into chaos—Human Fall Flat is wobbling onto Nintendo Switch 2 next spring! This physics-based action puzzle platformer from No Brakes Games lets you tackle kooky levels like Dockyard, Museum, Hike and more.
Whether you’re flying solo or teaming up with friends, expect hilariously unpredictable challenges and plenty of sticky situations when it launches in Spring 2026.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Human Fall Flat - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Reveal Trailer | Nintendo Direct

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Capcom has just revealed the official announce trailer for Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection, landing in 2026. This all-star compilation wraps up every entry in the Star Force saga—from Pegasus, Leo and Dragon to the Zerker duos (Ninja & Saurian) and the third chapter’s Black Ace and Red Joker.
Whether you’re chasing Wave Souls or reliving epic EM battles, this one’s a must for GBA-era nostalgia seekers.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection - Official Announce Trailer

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Delusion Out of Space is an upcoming Lovecraftian sci-fi horror shooter launching on Steam, Nintendo, Xbox, and PlayStation in 2026. You awaken alone on a derelict spaceship where failing systems, dark corridors, and a mysterious voice echoing in your mind set a twisted scene.
Once-tinkerer Tsen’tek of the Nyarlath race conducted dangerous consciousness experiments that spun wildly out of control. Now it’s up to you to venture deeper, make gut-wrenching choices, and face the fallout of his audacious lab work—your decisions will shape your fate and the ship’s sinister story.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Delusion Out of Space - Official Cinematic Trailer

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Delta Force x Saw Collaboration Trailer


Team Jade just dropped a sinister new crossover for Delta Force, blending its free-to-play multiplayer shooter action with the twisted world of Saw. Expect iconic traps, creepy atmospheres and themed gear to turn every match into a high-stakes puzzle.
The Saw collab goes live September 23 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android and PC—so sharpen your wits (and your weapons) before the games begin.  #IGN #Gaming
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Delta Force x Saw - Official Collaboration Trailer

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Hell is Us just dropped its Accolades Trailer, showing off the third-person action-adventure’s gripping world—a homeland torn apart by civil war and overrun with strange, deadly anomalies.  
Developed by Rogue Factor, the trailer highlights glowing reviews and fan reactions. You can jump into the chaos right now on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, or PC (Steam & Epic Games Store).
Watch on YouTube
